buddha-institute-of-technology.description: Buddha Institute of Technology is an AKTU-affiliated engineering college in the GIDA industrial area of Gorakhpur.
buddha-institute-of-technology.about: BIT was started in 2009 by the People Educational Society. It is approved by AICTE and affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University under college code 525. The campus is in Sector 7 of GIDA, Gorakhpur.
buddha-institute-of-technology.address: CL-1, Sector 7, GIDA, Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh 273209
buddha-institute-of-technology.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

institute-of-technology-and-management-3.description: Institute of Technology and Management, GIDA is an AKTU-affiliated engineering college on the Gorakhpur-Lucknow highway, about 12 km from Gorakhpur.
institute-of-technology-and-management-3.about: ITM was established in July 2001 under the Shree Krishna Educational Society. It began with B.Tech in ECE, CSE, IT and mechanical engineering plus MCA, and later added pharmacy, MBA and civil engineering. Its undergraduate engineering programmes are affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University.
institute-of-technology-and-management-3.address: AL-1, Sector-7, GIDA, Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh 273209
institute-of-technology-and-management-3.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

kipm-college-of-engineering-and-technolo.description: KIPM College of Engineering and Technology is an AKTU-affiliated engineering college in Sector 9 of GIDA, Gorakhpur.
kipm-college-of-engineering-and-technolo.about: The college was established in 2012. It is approved by AICTE and affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University. Its computer science, electronics and communication, and mechanical engineering programmes are NBA accredited.
kipm-college-of-engineering-and-technolo.address: KIPM Technical Campus, BL-1 and 2, Sector-9, GIDA, Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh 273209
kipm-college-of-engineering-and-technolo.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

madan-mohan-malaviya-university-of-techn.description: Madan Mohan Malaviya University of Technology is a non-affiliating state technical university on Deoria Road, Gorakhpur, accredited by NAAC with an A grade.
madan-mohan-malaviya-university-of-techn.about: The university was created by the Government of Uttar Pradesh in 2013 by reconstituting Madan Mohan Malaviya Engineering College, which dated from 1962. It is a non-affiliating technical university. It holds a NAAC A grade.

maharana-pratap-institute-of-technology.description: Maharana Pratap Institute of Technology is a private AKTU-affiliated engineering college on Gorakhnath Road, Gorakhpur, run under the Maharana Pratap Shiksha Parishad.
maharana-pratap-institute-of-technology.about: MPIT was established in 2024. It is one of 57 institutions under the Maharana Pratap Shiksha Parishad. It is approved by AICTE and affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, and offers B.Tech in computer science and its specialisations, IT and electronics (VLSI).
maharana-pratap-institute-of-technology.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

national-institute-of-electronics-and-in.description: NIELIT Gorakhpur is a centre of the National Institute of Electronics and Information Technology on Deoria Road, Gorakhpur, offering electronics and IT programmes.
national-institute-of-electronics-and-in.about: The centre was set up in June 1989 as the Centre for Electronics Design and Technology of India and was later part of the DOEACC Society. It runs M.Tech programmes affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, along with courses in embedded systems, VLSI, information security and networking.
national-institute-of-electronics-and-in.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

suyash-institute-of-information-technolo.description: Suyash Institute of Information Technology is an AKTU-affiliated college at Hakkabad in Gorakhpur offering engineering, pharmacy and allied programmes.
suyash-institute-of-information-technolo.about: SIIT was established in 2009. It is approved by AICTE and affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University. It offers B.Tech in six branches along with M.Tech, polytechnic, pharmacy, BBA, BCA and nursing courses.
suyash-institute-of-information-technolo.address: Hakkabad, Azad Chowk to Mirzapur Road, Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh 273016
suyash-institute-of-information-technolo.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

academy-of-technology-management-and-sci.description: Academy of Technology Management and Science is a college on the Hapur bypass offering B.Tech, pharmacy, management and education programmes.
academy-of-technology-management-and-sci.about: ATMS is located at the 49 km milestone of NH-24 near Nizampur Tiraha, Hapur. It holds AICTE approval and offers B.Tech in computer science, AI and ML, and electrical engineering. It also runs pharmacy, BCA, BBA, B.Ed and polytechnic courses.
academy-of-technology-management-and-sci.address: 49 Km Milestone, NH-24, Nizampur Tiraha, Hapur By Pass, Achheja, Hapur, Uttar Pradesh 245101
academy-of-technology-management-and-sci.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

maya-institute-of-pharmacy.description: Maya Institute of Pharmacy is a pharmacy college of the Maya Group of Institutions on Mendu Road, Hathras.
maya-institute-of-pharmacy.about: The Maya Group was founded in 2012. Its B.Pharm is approved by AICTE and PCI and affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, and its D.Pharm is under the state technical board. The group also offers MBA, B.Ed and D.El.Ed.
maya-institute-of-pharmacy.address: Mendu Road, Sokhna, Hathras, Uttar Pradesh 204101
maya-institute-of-pharmacy.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow
